title: PnP-DA: Towards Principled Plug-and-Play Integration of Variational Data Assimilation and Generative Models
testbed_rationale: The paper focuses on data assimilation algorithms evaluated on low-dimensional/idealized chaotic testbeds (Lorenz 63, Lorenz 96, and 1D Kuramoto-Sivashinsky) rather than climate parameterization datasets, and data/code links are not provided.
pain_points: Non-Gaussian, state-dependent error statistics in chaotic dynamical systems violate classical Gaussian error assumptions in variational DA (3D-Var/4D-Var).
Intractable Jacobian log-determinant when changing measure in deep generative latent spaces.
Expensive and numerically unstable gradient backpropagation through complex deep neural networks during iterative assimilation optimization.
Reconstruction errors introduced when projecting back from latent spaces.
extraction_notes: The paper introduces PnP-DA which integrates optimal transport Bayesian flow-matching priors into variational data assimilation without backpropagating gradients through the neural network. Evaluated purely on standard idealized dynamical toy models.
